archaic.definition: Archaic means belonging to an earlier period of time and no longer in current use.
archaic.task: Write one sentence of your own using the word archaic. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know archaic should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: Archaic means belonging to an earlier period of time and no longer in current use.
Much of his vocabulary felt archaic, so tied to his own century that Priya sometimes had to guess at his meaning.
In her grandmother's attic, Maya found archaic letters written in a spidery hand, words she'd never seen before because the language itself had changed so much.
Archaic means something is not just old, but specifically old and no longer in use.
It's more precise than "ancient" (which emphasizes age but not disuse) or "old" (which says nothing about whether the thing is still used).
These letters belong to a vanished era of language — that's exactly what archaic captures.
